card.name: Scattered mid-text words and digits
card.fires_on: No single word type fits. It fires on odd spots such as 'Over' before a number, 'Date' in 'Review Date', digits inside phone numbers or DOIs, and 'over' in 'over time'.

modes.label: Over/over
modes.description: The word over at the start of a phrase or after a verb.

modes.label: Digits in codes
modes.description: A single digit inside a phone number, DOI or catalog number.

modes.label: Web and label words
modes.description: Words in page boilerplate such as Date or Notifications.

card.plain: It fires on a mix of unrelated words and digits with no common theme.
